directories.current-error.json: Current unresolved operational error alert, when one exists.
directories.debug-sessions: Selenium UI debugger manifests, screenshots, console logs, and network errors.
directories.errors: Archived fixed, superseded, and historical operational error alerts.
directories.failed: Messages moved here with sibling .error.txt files when processing fails.
directories.inbox: Pending messages grouped by recipient agent id.
directories.processed: Messages moved here after a handler or worker accepts them.
directories.records/messages: Current lifecycle record for every known message, including payload.
directories.records/tasks: Controller-created task records linked to task_request messages and runtime runs.

purpose: Durable transparent agent messaging, task assignment, and UI debug artifacts.
